vocabulary_focus.concept: Please inform me / Let me know

expressions.en: Please inform me / Let me know
expressions.bm_formal: Sila maklumkan saya / Sila beritahu saya

vocabulary_focus.concept: I will get back to you / I will revert

expressions.en: I will get back to you / I will revert
expressions.cn: 我会回复你 / 我会再联系你
expressions.bm_formal: Saya akan maklum balas / Saya akan kembali kepada anda
expressions.bm_casual: Saya akan reply / Saya akan inform balik

vocabulary_focus.concept: Could you clarify? / Can you explain further?

expressions.en: Could you clarify? / Can you explain further?
expressions.cn: 你能澄清一下吗？ / 你能再解释一下吗？
expressions.bm_formal: Boleh anda jelaskan lebih lanjut? / Boleh anda huraikan?
expressions.bm_casual: Boleh tak explain lagi? / Boleh clarify sikit?

vocabulary_focus.concept: I apologize for the inconvenience / Sorry for the trouble

expressions.en: I apologize for the inconvenience / Sorry for the trouble
expressions.cn: 我为造成的不便道歉 / 抱歉造成麻烦
expressions.bm_formal: Saya memohon maaf atas kesulitan ini / Saya minta maaf atas kesulitan yang berlaku
expressions.bm_casual: Sorry ye / Maaf ye / Sorry ganggu

work.scenario: You are in a team meeting discussing a new project timeline and roles. You need to ensure everyone is clear on their tasks and the deadline.
key_phrases: Sila sahkan tarikh akhir penyerahan tugas anda.
Saya akan maklum balas mengenai bajet esok.
Boleh anda jelaskan lebih lanjut mengenai peranan setiap ahli pasukan?

life.scenario: You are coordinating a weekend hiking trip with a group of friends. You need to confirm attendance, share details, and apologize for any last-minute changes.
key_phrases: Boleh tak confirm siapa yang nak pergi hiking?
Bagitau saya kalau ada sesiapa yang tak dapat datang.
Sorry ye, kita terpaksa anjak masa sikit.

tech.scenario: You are troubleshooting a software issue with a technical support agent over the phone or chat. You need to understand their instructions and confirm steps.
key_phrases: Boleh anda jelaskan lebih lanjut langkah-langkah ini?
Faham, saya akan cuba ikut arahan ini.
Sila sahkan bahawa masalah telah diselesaikan.

quiz_toggle.question: How to casually ask 'Can you explain this process again?'
quiz_toggle.answer: Boleh tak explain process ni lagi?

quiz_toggle.question: What's the formal Malay for 'I understand your concern'?
